capabilities: Auto-apply a configurable status tag to every new note
Triage tagged notes in a stacked card queue with keyboard shortcuts
Apply, remove, or cycle the active status tag via commands
Configure multiple status tags and choose the active one in settings
disambiguation: Not a note-quality or link checker; it only tracks notes by applying and reviewing status tags.
extras: Manual installation only for now (community plugin review pending); README states the software was vibe coded.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to flag new notes as unfinished and later work through them in a review queue.
summary: Status-tag workflow that auto-tags new notes (default #INCOMPLETE) and offers commands plus a card-based triage queue to review and clear them.
